mutable struct TACBlock
    number::Int
    labels::Vector{String}
    start::Int
    finish::Int
    instructions::Vector{Int}
    predecessors::Vector{Int}
    successors::Vector{Int}
end
TACBlock(number,labels,start) = TACBlock(number,copy(labels),start,0,Int[],Int[],Int[])
mutable struct TACLoop
    header::Int
    latches::Vector{Int}
    blocks::BitSet
    depth::Int
    exits::BitSet
    outside::BitSet
end
Base.@kwdef mutable struct TACCFG
    function_node::TACFunction
    blocks::Vector{TACBlock} = TACBlock[]
    instructions::Vector{TACInstruction} = TACInstruction[]
    positions::Vector{Int} = Int[]
    block_of::Vector{Int} = Int[]
    reachable::BitSet = BitSet()
    postorder::Vector{Int} = Int[]
    reverse_postorder::Vector{Int} = Int[]
    reachable_predecessors::Vector{Vector{Int}} = Vector{Int}[]
    dominators::Vector{BitSet} = BitSet[]
    immediate::Vector{Int} = Int[]
    loops::Vector{TACLoop} = TACLoop[]
    depth::Vector{Int} = Int[]
end
function TACCFG(function_node)
    graph = TACCFG(function_node=function_node)
    pending,first_label = String[],0
    current,previous_kind = nothing,""
    for (index,line) in enumerate(function_node.code)
        if line isa String
            isempty(pending) && (first_label = index)
            push!(pending,line)
            continue
        end
        number = length(graph.instructions)+1
        if current === nothing || !isempty(pending) || previous_kind in ("goto","if","return")
            start = isempty(pending) ? index : first_label
            current !== nothing && (current.finish = start)
            current = TACBlock(length(graph.blocks)+1,pending,start)
            push!(graph.blocks,current)
            pending = String[]
        end
        push!(graph.instructions,line)
        push!(graph.positions,index)
        push!(graph.block_of,current.number)
        push!(current.instructions,number)
        previous_kind = line.kind
    end
    current.finish = length(function_node.code)+1
    labels = Dict(label=>block.number for block in graph.blocks for label in block.labels)
    for block in graph.blocks
        last = graph.instructions[block.instructions[end]]
        if last.kind == "goto"
            block.successors = [labels[last.name]]
        elseif last.kind == "if"
            block.successors = unique([block.number+1,labels[last.name]])
        elseif last.kind != "return"
            block.successors = [block.number+1]
        end
        for successor in block.successors
            push!(graph.blocks[successor].predecessors,block.number)
        end
    end
    push!(graph.reachable,1)
    stack = [(1,1)]
    while !isempty(stack)
        number,index = stack[end]
        successors = graph.blocks[number].successors
        if index > length(successors)
            push!(graph.postorder,number)
            pop!(stack)
        else
            stack[end] = (number,index+1)
            successor = successors[index]
            if !(successor in graph.reachable)
                push!(graph.reachable,successor)
                push!(stack,(successor,1))
            end
        end
    end
    graph.reverse_postorder = reverse(graph.postorder)
    graph.reachable_predecessors = [filter(number->number in graph.reachable,block.predecessors) for block in graph.blocks]
    graph.dominators = [number in graph.reachable ? copy(graph.reachable) : BitSet() for number in eachindex(graph.blocks)]
    graph.dominators[1] = BitSet([1])
    changed = true
    while changed
        changed = false
        for number in graph.reverse_postorder[2:end]
            predecessors = graph.reachable_predecessors[number]
            value = copy(graph.dominators[predecessors[1]])
            for predecessor in predecessors[2:end]
                intersect!(value,graph.dominators[predecessor])
            end
            push!(value,number)
            if value != graph.dominators[number]
                graph.dominators[number] = value
                changed = true
            end
        end
    end
    graph.immediate = zeros(Int,length(graph.blocks))
    for number in sort(collect(setdiff(graph.reachable,BitSet([1]))))
        graph.immediate[number] = argmax(parent->length(graph.dominators[parent]),setdiff(graph.dominators[number],BitSet([number])))
    end
    for header in graph.reachable
        latches = filter(number->header in graph.dominators[number],graph.reachable_predecessors[header])
        isempty(latches) && continue
        members = BitSet([header;latches])
        pending = filter(!=(header),latches)
        while !isempty(pending)
            number = pop!(pending)
            for predecessor in graph.reachable_predecessors[number]
                if !(predecessor in members)
                    push!(members,predecessor)
                    push!(pending,predecessor)
                end
            end
        end
        push!(graph.loops,TACLoop(header,latches,members,0,BitSet(),BitSet()))
    end
    graph.depth = [count(loop->number in loop.blocks,graph.loops) for number in eachindex(graph.blocks)]
    for loop in graph.loops
        loop.depth = count(other->loop.header in other.blocks,graph.loops)
        for number in loop.blocks
            block = graph.blocks[number]
            outside = setdiff(BitSet(block.successors),loop.blocks)
            union!(loop.outside,outside)
            (!isempty(outside) || graph.instructions[block.instructions[end]].kind == "return") && push!(loop.exits,number)
        end
    end
    graph
end

const TACDefinition = Tuple{String,Int}
const TACCopy = Tuple{String,String}
function reaching_transfer(entry,number,state)
    entry.destination === nothing && return copy(state)
    result = Set{TACDefinition}(definition for definition in state if definition[1] != entry.destination)
    push!(result,(entry.destination,number))
    result
end
function live_transfer(entry,state)
    result = copy(state)
    entry.destination !== nothing && delete!(result,entry.destination)
    union!(result,used_variables(entry))
end
function expression_transfer(entry,number,state)
    result = copy(state)
    value = expression(entry)
    value !== nothing && push!(result,value)
    entry.kind == "store" && filter!(value->!(value[1] == "load" && value[2] == entry.name),result)
    entry.kind == "call" && filter!(value->value[1] != "load",result)
    entry.destination !== nothing && filter!(value->!(entry.destination in value[3:4]),result)
    result
end
function copy_transfer(entry,number,state)
    result = Set{TACCopy}(pair for pair in state if !(entry.destination in pair))
    entry.kind == "copy" && entry.a isa String && entry.destination != entry.a && push!(result,(entry.destination,entry.a))
    result
end
function forward_flow(graph,kind,transfer,universe::Set{T}) where T
    incoming = Dict{Int,Set{T}}()
    outgoing = Dict(number=>copy(universe) for number in graph.reachable)
    iterations = 0
    while true
        changed = false
        iterations += 1
        for number in graph.reverse_postorder
            predecessors = graph.reachable_predecessors[number]
            if kind == "reaching"
                state = Set{T}()
                for predecessor in predecessors
                    union!(state,outgoing[predecessor])
                end
                number == 1 && union!(state,((parameter,0) for parameter in graph.function_node.parameters))
            elseif number == 1
                state = Set{T}()
            else
                state = copy(outgoing[predecessors[1]])
                for predecessor in predecessors[2:end]
                    intersect!(state,outgoing[predecessor])
                end
            end
            incoming[number] = copy(state)
            for instruction_number in graph.blocks[number].instructions
                state = transfer(graph.instructions[instruction_number],instruction_number,state)
            end
            if state != outgoing[number]
                outgoing[number] = state
                changed = true
            end
        end
        !changed && return incoming,outgoing,iterations
    end
end
function liveness(graph)
    incoming = Dict(number=>Set{String}() for number in graph.reachable)
    outgoing = Dict{Int,Set{String}}()
    iterations = 0
    while true
        changed = false
        iterations += 1
        for number in graph.postorder
            state = Set{String}()
            for successor in graph.blocks[number].successors
                union!(state,incoming[successor])
            end
            outgoing[number] = copy(state)
            for instruction_number in reverse(graph.blocks[number].instructions)
                state = live_transfer(graph.instructions[instruction_number],state)
            end
            if state != incoming[number]
                incoming[number] = state
                changed = true
            end
        end
        !changed && return incoming,outgoing,iterations
    end
end
function boundaries(graph,incoming,transfer)
    result = empty(incoming)
    for block in graph.reachable
        state = copy(incoming[block])
        for number in graph.blocks[block].instructions
            result[number] = copy(state)
            state = transfer(graph.instructions[number],number,state)
        end
    end
    result
end
struct TACDataFlow
    iterations::Dict{String,Int}
    reaching_in::Dict{Int,Set{TACDefinition}}
    reaching_out::Dict{Int,Set{TACDefinition}}
    live_in::Dict{Int,Set{String}}
    live_out::Dict{Int,Set{String}}
    expression_in::Dict{Int,Set{TACExpression}}
    expression_out::Dict{Int,Set{TACExpression}}
    copy_in::Dict{Int,Set{TACCopy}}
    copy_out::Dict{Int,Set{TACCopy}}
    reaching_before::Dict{Int,Set{TACDefinition}}
    expression_before::Dict{Int,Set{TACExpression}}
    copy_before::Dict{Int,Set{TACCopy}}
    live_before::Dict{Int,Set{String}}
    live_after::Dict{Int,Set{String}}
end
function TACDataFlow(graph)
    expressions,copies = Set{TACExpression}(),Set{TACCopy}()
    for (number,entry) in enumerate(graph.instructions)
        graph.block_of[number] in graph.reachable || continue
        value = expression(entry)
        value !== nothing && push!(expressions,value)
        entry.kind == "copy" && entry.a isa String && entry.destination != entry.a && push!(copies,(entry.destination,entry.a))
    end
    reaching_in,reaching_out,reaching_iterations = forward_flow(graph,"reaching",reaching_transfer,Set{TACDefinition}())
    live_in,live_out,live_iterations = liveness(graph)
    expression_in,expression_out,expression_iterations = forward_flow(graph,"expressions",expression_transfer,expressions)
    copy_in,copy_out,copy_iterations = forward_flow(graph,"copies",copy_transfer,copies)
    live_before,live_after = Dict{Int,Set{String}}(),Dict{Int,Set{String}}()
    for block in graph.reachable
        state = copy(live_out[block])
        for number in reverse(graph.blocks[block].instructions)
            live_after[number] = copy(state)
            state = live_transfer(graph.instructions[number],state)
            live_before[number] = copy(state)
        end
    end
    TACDataFlow(Dict("reaching"=>reaching_iterations,"liveness"=>live_iterations,"expressions"=>expression_iterations,"copies"=>copy_iterations),
        reaching_in,reaching_out,live_in,live_out,expression_in,expression_out,copy_in,copy_out,
        boundaries(graph,reaching_in,reaching_transfer),boundaries(graph,expression_in,expression_transfer),
        boundaries(graph,copy_in,copy_transfer),live_before,live_after)
end

include("tac_parser.jl")
include("cfg.jl")
include("dataflow.jl")
include("optimizations.jl")
include("regalloc.jl")

const PASS_ORDER = ["constprop","copyprop","cse","dce","licm","unreachable"]
const VERSIONS = ["original","optimized","allocated"]
comma_list(values) = isempty(values) ? "-" : join(string.(collect(values)),",")
block_list(numbers) = comma_list(["B$number" for number in numbers])
instruction_list(numbers) = comma_list(["#$number" for number in numbers])
function read_settings()
    lines = readlines("input/params.txt")
    registers = parse(Int,split(lines[1])[2])
    enabled = Set(split(lines[2])[2:end])
    maximum_rounds = parse(Int,split(lines[3])[2])
    registers,filter(name->name in enabled,PASS_ORDER),maximum_rounds
end
function read_runs()
    lines = readlines("input/input.txt")
    runs = Vector{Int}[]
    for line in lines[2:parse(Int,lines[1])+1]
        values = parse.(Int,split(line))
        push!(runs,values[2:values[1]+1])
    end
    runs
end
reachable_numbers(graph) = [number for number in eachindex(graph.instructions) if graph.block_of[number] in graph.reachable]
reaching_numbers(flow,number,variable) = Set(definition for (name,definition) in flow.reaching_before[number] if name == variable)
function constant_value(graph,definitions)
    (isempty(definitions) || 0 in definitions) && return nothing
    value = nothing
    for number in definitions
        entry = graph.instructions[number]
        (entry.kind != "copy" || !(entry.a isa Int)) && return nothing
        value !== nothing && value != entry.a && return nothing
        value = entry.a
    end
    value
end
function constant_propagation!(function_node,graph,flow)
    replacements,records = Dict{Int,Vector{TACCode}}(),String[]
    for number in reachable_numbers(graph)
        original = graph.instructions[number]
        entry = original
        for field in operand_fields(original)
            variable = getproperty(original,field)
            variable isa String || continue
            value = constant_value(graph,reaching_numbers(flow,number,variable))
            if value !== nothing
                entry = field == :a ? replace_instruction(entry;a=value) : replace_instruction(entry;b=value)
                push!(records,"#$number: $variable -> $value")
            end
        end
        result,folded = fold_instruction(entry)
        if result === nothing
            push!(records,"#$number: delete " * instruction_string(entry))
            replacements[number] = TACCode[]
        else
            folded && push!(records,"#$number: fold " * instruction_string(result))
            replacements[number] = TACCode[result]
        end
    end
    rewrite_code!(function_node,replacements)
    length(records),records
end
function copy_propagation!(function_node,graph,flow)
    replacements,records = Dict{Int,Vector{TACCode}}(),String[]
    for number in reachable_numbers(graph)
        original = graph.instructions[number]
        entry = original
        available = Dict(flow.copy_before[number])
        for field in operand_fields(original)
            variable = getproperty(original,field)
            if variable isa String && haskey(available,variable)
                replacement = available[variable]
                entry = field == :a ? replace_instruction(entry;a=replacement) : replace_instruction(entry;b=replacement)
                push!(records,"#$number: $variable -> $replacement")
            end
        end
        replacements[number] = TACCode[entry]
    end
    rewrite_code!(function_node,replacements)
    length(records),records
end
function expression_sources(graph,value,candidate)
    block_number = graph.block_of[candidate]
    for number in reverse(graph.blocks[block_number].instructions)
        number < candidate && expression(graph.instructions[number]) == value && return BitSet([number])
    end
    sources,examined = BitSet(),BitSet()
    pending = copy(graph.reachable_predecessors[block_number])
    while !isempty(pending)
        number = pop!(pending)
        number in examined && continue
        push!(examined,number)
        found = false
        for instruction_number in reverse(graph.blocks[number].instructions)
            if expression(graph.instructions[instruction_number]) == value
                push!(sources,instruction_number)
                found = true
                break
            end
        end
        !found && append!(pending,graph.reachable_predecessors[number])
    end
    sources
end
function common_subexpressions!(function_node,graph,flow)
    candidates = Dict{TACExpression,Vector{Int}}()
    for number in reachable_numbers(graph)
        value = expression(graph.instructions[number])
        if value !== nothing && value in flow.expression_before[number]
            push!(get!(candidates,value,Int[]),number)
        end
    end
    replacements,records,changes = Dict{Int,Vector{TACCode}}(),String[],0
    for (value,numbers) in sort(collect(candidates);by=pair->pair.second[1])
        sources = BitSet()
        for number in numbers
            union!(sources,expression_sources(graph,value,number))
        end
        setdiff!(sources,numbers)
        temporary,edits = cse_replacements!(function_node,graph,sources,numbers)
        merge!(replacements,edits)
        push!(records,"$(expression_string(value)): $temporary sources=$(instruction_list(sources)) replaced=$(instruction_list(numbers))")
        changes += length(numbers)
    end
    rewrite_code!(function_node,replacements)
    changes,records
end
function dead_code!(function_node,graph,flow)
    replacements,records = Dict{Int,Vector{TACCode}}(),Tuple{Int,String}[]
    for block_number in graph.reachable
        state = copy(flow.live_out[block_number])
        for number in reverse(graph.blocks[block_number].instructions)
            entry = graph.instructions[number]
            destination = entry.destination
            self_copy = entry.kind == "copy" && destination == entry.a
            dead_assignment = entry.kind in ("copy","bin","load") && !(destination in state)
            if self_copy || dead_assignment
                replacements[number] = TACCode[]
                push!(records,(number,"#$number: delete " * instruction_string(entry)))
                continue
            end
            if entry.kind == "call" && destination !== nothing && !(destination in state)
                push!(records,(number,"#$number: unused result " * instruction_string(entry)))
                entry = replace_instruction(entry;destination=nothing)
                replacements[number] = TACCode[entry]
            end
            state = live_transfer(entry,state)
        end
    end
    rewrite_code!(function_node,replacements)
    ordered = [record for (number,record) in sort(records;by=first)]
    length(ordered),ordered
end
inside_definitions(graph,loop,definitions) = BitSet(number for number in definitions if number != 0 && graph.block_of[number] in loop.blocks)
function invariant_operand(graph,flow,loop,number,variable,marked)
    definitions = reaching_numbers(flow,number,variable)
    inside = inside_definitions(graph,loop,definitions)
    isempty(inside) || (length(definitions) == 1 && issubset(inside,marked))
end
function marked_invariants(graph,flow,loop,numbers)
    stores = Set(graph.instructions[number].name for number in numbers if graph.instructions[number].kind == "store")
    calls = any(number->graph.instructions[number].kind == "call",numbers)
    marked,order = BitSet(),Int[]
    while true
        changed = false
        for number in numbers
            entry = graph.instructions[number]
            (number in marked || !(entry.kind in ("copy","bin","load"))) && continue
            entry.kind == "load" && (calls || entry.name in stores) && continue
            if all(variable->invariant_operand(graph,flow,loop,number,variable,marked),used_variables(entry))
                push!(marked,number)
                push!(order,number)
                changed = true
            end
        end
        !changed && return order
    end
end
function movable_invariants(graph,flow,loop,numbers,marked_order)
    definitions = Dict{String,Int}()
    for number in numbers
        destination = graph.instructions[number].destination
        destination !== nothing && (definitions[destination] = get(definitions,destination,0)+1)
    end
    moved,order = BitSet(),Int[]
    for number in marked_order
        entry = graph.instructions[number]
        destination = entry.destination
        (definitions[destination] != 1 || destination in flow.live_in[loop.header]) && continue
        block_number = graph.block_of[number]
        dominates_exits = all(exit_block->block_number in graph.dominators[exit_block],loop.exits)
        dangerous = entry.kind == "load" || (entry.kind == "bin" && entry.operation in ("/","%") && (entry.b isa String || entry.b == 0))
        dead_outside = all(successor->!(destination in flow.live_in[successor]),loop.outside)
        !dominates_exits && (dangerous || !dead_outside) && continue
        ready = all(variable->issubset(inside_definitions(graph,loop,reaching_numbers(flow,number,variable)),moved),used_variables(entry))
        if ready
            push!(moved,number)
            push!(order,number)
        end
    end
    order
end
function loop_invariant_motion!(function_node,graph,flow)
    for loop in sort(graph.loops;by=loop->(length(loop.blocks),loop.header))
        numbers = sort([number for block in loop.blocks for number in graph.blocks[block].instructions])
        moves = movable_invariants(graph,flow,loop,numbers,marked_invariants(graph,flow,loop,numbers))
        if !isempty(moves)
            destination = hoist!(function_node,graph,loop,moves)
            return length(moves),["B$(loop.header): hoist $(instruction_list(moves)) to $destination"]
        end
    end
    0,String[]
end
function unreachable_code!(function_node,graph,flow)
    blocks,jumps,labels = remove_unreachable!(function_node,graph)
    records = [["remove block B$number" for number in blocks];["remove jump #$number" for number in jumps];["remove label $label" for label in labels]]
    length(records),records
end
const PASSES = Dict("constprop"=>constant_propagation!,"copyprop"=>copy_propagation!,"cse"=>common_subexpressions!,
    "dce"=>dead_code!,"licm"=>loop_invariant_motion!,"unreachable"=>unreachable_code!)
function optimize_function!(function_node,enabled,maximum_rounds,totals)
    original_count = length(instructions(function_node))
    lines = ["== $(function_node.name) =="]
    rounds = 0
    for round_number in 1:maximum_rounds
        rounds = round_number
        counts,records = Int[],String[]
        for name in enabled
            graph = TACCFG(function_node)
            flow = TACDataFlow(graph)
            count,pass_records = PASSES[name](function_node,graph,flow)
            push!(counts,count)
            totals[name] += count
            append!(records,["  $name $record" for record in pass_records])
        end
        push!(lines,"round $round_number: " * join(("$name=$count" for (name,count) in zip(enabled,counts))," "))
        append!(lines,records)
        all(==(0),counts) && break
    end
    push!(lines,"result: rounds=$rounds instructions=$original_count->$(length(instructions(function_node)))")
    lines
end
function reachable_names(callees,starts)
    reached = Set{String}()
    pending = collect(starts)
    while !isempty(pending)
        name = pop!(pending)
        if !(name in reached)
            push!(reached,name)
            append!(pending,callees[name])
        end
    end
    reached
end
function call_graph(program)
    names = [function_node.name for function_node in program.functions]
    callees = Dict{String,Vector{String}}()
    for function_node in program.functions
        called = Set(entry.name for entry in instructions(function_node) if entry.kind == "call")
        callees[function_node.name] = filter(name->name in called,names)
    end
    recursive = Set(name for name in names if name in reachable_names(callees,callees[name]))
    callees,reachable_names(callees,["main"]),recursive
end
function call_graph_lines(program,heading)
    callees,reachable,recursive = call_graph(program)
    lines = ["== call graph ($heading) =="]
    for function_node in program.functions
        name = function_node.name
        push!(lines,"$name -> $(comma_list(callees[name]))" * (name in recursive ? " (recursive)" : ""))
    end
    push!(lines,"unreachable functions: " * comma_list([f.name for f in program.functions if !(f.name in reachable)]))
    lines,reachable
end
definition_list(definitions) = comma_list(["$variable:$number" for (variable,number) in sort(collect(definitions);by=pair->(pair[2],pair[1]))])
function function_analysis(function_node,heading)
    graph = TACCFG(function_node)
    flow = TACDataFlow(graph)
    lines = ["== $(function_node.name) ($heading) ==","code:"]
    number = 0
    for line in function_node.code
        if line isa String
            push!(lines,line * ":")
            continue
        end
        number += 1
        text = "  #$number " * instruction_string(line)
        if graph.block_of[number] in graph.reachable
            variables = unique(used_variables(line))
            if !isempty(variables)
                chains = ["$variable:$(comma_list(sort(collect(reaching_numbers(flow,number,variable)))))" for variable in variables]
                text *= " | " * join(chains," ")
            end
        end
        push!(lines,text)
    end
    push!(lines,"blocks: $(length(graph.blocks))")
    for block in graph.blocks
        push!(lines,"B$(block.number) $(block.instructions[1])-$(block.instructions[end]) labels=$(comma_list(block.labels)) preds=$(block_list(block.predecessors)) succs=$(block_list(block.successors))")
    end
    push!(lines,"unreachable: " * block_list([number for number in eachindex(graph.blocks) if !(number in graph.reachable)]))
    push!(lines,"order: " * block_list(graph.reverse_postorder),"dominators:")
    for number in graph.reachable
        parent = graph.immediate[number]
        push!(lines,"B$number idom=$(parent == 0 ? "-" : "B$parent") dom=$(block_list(graph.dominators[number]))")
    end
    push!(lines,"dominator tree:")
    stack = [(1,0)]
    while !isempty(stack)
        number,depth = pop!(stack)
        push!(lines,"  "^depth * "B$number")
        children = [child for child in eachindex(graph.immediate) if graph.immediate[child] == number]
        append!(stack,[(child,depth+1) for child in reverse(children)])
    end
    push!(lines,"loops: $(length(graph.loops))")
    for loop in graph.loops
        push!(lines,"header=B$(loop.header) latches=$(block_list(loop.latches)) depth=$(loop.depth) blocks=$(block_list(loop.blocks)) exits=$(block_list(loop.exits))")
    end
    analyses = (("reaching definitions","reaching",flow.reaching_in,flow.reaching_out,definition_list),
        ("liveness","liveness",flow.live_in,flow.live_out,state->comma_list(sort(collect(state)))),
        ("available expressions","expressions",flow.expression_in,flow.expression_out,state->comma_list(sort(expression_string.(collect(state))))))
    for (title,key,incoming,outgoing,render) in analyses
        push!(lines,"$title: iterations=$(flow.iterations[key])")
        for number in graph.reachable
            push!(lines,"B$number in=$(render(incoming[number])) out=$(render(outgoing[number]))")
        end
    end
    lines
end
function rewrite_registers(function_node,colors)
    names = Dict(variable=>"R$color" for (variable,color) in colors if color >= 0)
    code,moves = TACCode[],0
    for line in function_node.code
        if line isa String
            push!(code,line)
            continue
        end
        destination = line.destination === nothing ? nothing : get(names,line.destination,line.destination)
        a = line.a isa String ? get(names,line.a,line.a) : line.a
        b = line.b isa String ? get(names,line.b,line.b) : line.b
        entry = replace_instruction(line;destination=destination,a=a,b=b)
        if entry.kind == "copy" && entry.destination == entry.a
            moves += 1
        else
            push!(code,entry)
        end
    end
    parameters = [get(names,parameter,parameter) for parameter in function_node.parameters]
    TACFunction(function_node.name,parameters,code),moves
end
function allocation_report(function_node,registers)
    graph = TACCFG(function_node)
    flow = TACDataFlow(graph)
    allocation = TACAllocation(function_node,graph,flow,registers)
    allocated,moves = rewrite_registers(function_node,allocation.colors)
    nodes = sort(collect(keys(allocation.neighbors)))
    edges = div(sum(length,values(allocation.neighbors);init=0),2)
    lines = ["== $(function_node.name) ==","nodes=$(length(nodes)) edges=$edges registers=$registers"]
    for node in nodes
        neighbors = allocation.neighbors[node]
        push!(lines,"$node degree=$(length(neighbors)) cost=$(allocation.costs[node]) neighbors=$(comma_list(sort(collect(neighbors))))")
    end
    push!(lines,"simplify: " * comma_list(allocation.order))
    push!(lines,"potential spills: " * comma_list(["$node($(allocation.costs[node])/$degree)" for (node,degree) in allocation.potential]))
    for node in nodes
        color = allocation.colors[node]
        push!(lines,"$node -> " * (color < 0 ? "spill" : "R$color"))
    end
    pressure = maximum([0;length.(collect(values(flow.live_before)));length.(collect(values(flow.live_after)))])
    used = length(Set(color for color in values(allocation.colors) if color >= 0))
    spills = allocation.spills
    spill_uses = sum((count(variable->variable in spills,used_variables(entry)) for entry in instructions(function_node));init=0)
    spill_defs = count(entry->entry.destination in spills,instructions(function_node))+count(parameter->parameter in spills,function_node.parameters)
    push!(lines,"summary: pressure=$pressure used=$used spilled=$(length(spills)) moves=$moves spill_uses=$spill_uses spill_defs=$spill_defs")
    append!(lines,function_lines(allocated))
    allocated,lines
end
struct ExecutableTACFunction
    parameters::Vector{String}
    instructions::Vector{TACInstruction}
    labels::Dict{String,Int}
end
mutable struct TACInterpreter
    functions::Dict{String,ExecutableTACFunction}
    arrays::Dict{String,Vector{Int}}
    inputs::Vector{Int}
    input_position::Int
    output::Vector{Int}
    steps::Dict{String,Int}
    calls::Dict{String,Int}
    kinds::Dict{String,Int}
end
function TACInterpreter(program,inputs)
    functions = Dict{String,ExecutableTACFunction}()
    for function_node in program.functions
        labels,code = Dict{String,Int}(),TACInstruction[]
        for line in function_node.code
            line isa String ? (labels[line] = length(code)+1) : push!(code,line)
        end
        functions[function_node.name] = ExecutableTACFunction(function_node.parameters,code,labels)
    end
    TACInterpreter(functions,Dict(name=>zeros(Int,size) for (name,size) in program.arrays),inputs,1,Int[],
        Dict(name=>0 for name in keys(functions)),Dict(name=>0 for name in keys(functions)),Dict(kind=>0 for kind in KINDS))
end
value_of(operand,variables) = operand isa String ? variables[operand] : operand
function call_tac!(interpreter,name,arguments)
    function_node = interpreter.functions[name]
    variables = Dict{String,Int}(zip(function_node.parameters,arguments))
    pushed,position = Int[],1
    interpreter.calls[name] += 1
    while true
        entry = function_node.instructions[position]
        position += 1
        interpreter.steps[name] += 1
        interpreter.kinds[entry.kind] += 1
        kind = entry.kind
        if kind == "copy"
            variables[entry.destination] = value_of(entry.a,variables)
        elseif kind == "bin"
            variables[entry.destination] = calculate(entry.operation,value_of(entry.a,variables),value_of(entry.b,variables))
        elseif kind == "load"
            variables[entry.destination] = interpreter.arrays[entry.name][value_of(entry.a,variables)+1]
        elseif kind == "store"
            interpreter.arrays[entry.name][value_of(entry.a,variables)+1] = value_of(entry.b,variables)
        elseif kind == "goto"
            position = function_node.labels[entry.name]
        elseif kind == "if"
            calculate(entry.operation,value_of(entry.a,variables),value_of(entry.b,variables)) != 0 && (position = function_node.labels[entry.name])
        elseif kind == "param"
            push!(pushed,value_of(entry.a,variables))
        elseif kind == "call"
            arguments = entry.count == 0 ? Int[] : pushed[end-entry.count+1:end]
            entry.count != 0 && resize!(pushed,length(pushed)-entry.count)
            result = call_tac!(interpreter,entry.name,arguments)
            entry.destination !== nothing && (variables[entry.destination] = result)
        elseif kind == "return"
            return value_of(entry.a,variables)
        elseif kind == "read"
            variables[entry.destination] = interpreter.inputs[interpreter.input_position]
            interpreter.input_position += 1
        else
            push!(interpreter.output,value_of(entry.a,variables))
        end
    end
end
function static_kinds(program)
    counts = Dict(kind=>0 for kind in KINDS)
    for function_node in program.functions,entry in instructions(function_node)
        counts[entry.kind] += 1
    end
    counts
end
function comparison_report(original,optimized,allocated,runs)
    programs = [original,optimized,allocated]
    profiles = Dict(version=>Dict(function_node.name=>0 for function_node in original.functions) for version in VERSIONS)
    dynamic = Dict(version=>Dict(kind=>0 for kind in KINDS) for version in VERSIONS)
    total_steps = Dict(version=>0 for version in VERSIONS)
    original_calls = Dict(function_node.name=>0 for function_node in original.functions)
    lines,same = String[],0
    for (run_number,inputs) in enumerate(runs)
        push!(lines,"run $run_number: inputs=$(length(inputs))")
        outputs = Vector{Int}[]
        for (version,program) in zip(VERSIONS,programs)
            interpreter = TACInterpreter(program,inputs)
            call_tac!(interpreter,"main",Int[])
            steps,calls = sum(values(interpreter.steps);init=0),sum(values(interpreter.calls);init=0)
            push!(lines,"  $version: steps=$steps calls=$calls output=$(comma_list(interpreter.output))")
            for (name,count) in interpreter.steps
                profiles[version][name] += count
            end
            for kind in KINDS
                dynamic[version][kind] += interpreter.kinds[kind]
            end
            total_steps[version] += steps
            if version == "original"
                for (name,count) in interpreter.calls
                    original_calls[name] += count
                end
            end
            push!(outputs,interpreter.output)
        end
        equal = outputs[1] == outputs[2] == outputs[3]
        same += Int(equal)
        push!(lines,"  result: " * (equal ? "same" : "different"))
    end
    push!(lines,"== profile ==")
    for function_node in original.functions
        name = function_node.name
        push!(lines,"$name: calls=$(original_calls[name]) original=$(profiles["original"][name]) optimized=$(profiles["optimized"][name]) allocated=$(profiles["allocated"][name])")
    end
    original_kinds,optimized_kinds = static_kinds(original),static_kinds(optimized)
    push!(lines,"== summary ==","runs=$(length(runs)) same=$same different=$(length(runs)-same)")
    push!(lines,"instructions: original=$(sum(values(original_kinds))) optimized=$(sum(values(optimized_kinds)))")
    push!(lines,"kinds: " * join(("$kind=$(original_kinds[kind])->$(optimized_kinds[kind])" for kind in KINDS)," "))
    push!(lines,"steps: " * join(("$version=$(total_steps[version])" for version in VERSIONS)," "))
    for version in VERSIONS
        push!(lines,"dynamic $version: " * join(("$kind=$(dynamic[version][kind])" for kind in KINDS)," "))
    end
    lines
end
function main()
    registers,enabled,maximum_rounds = read_settings()
    runs = read_runs()
    original = read_program("input/program.tac")
    analysis,_ = call_graph_lines(original,"original")
    for function_node in original.functions
        append!(analysis,function_analysis(function_node,"original"))
    end
    working = TACProgram(copy(original.arrays),[TACFunction(f.name,copy(f.parameters),copy(f.code)) for f in original.functions])
    pass_lines,totals = String[],Dict(name=>0 for name in enabled)
    for function_node in working.functions
        append!(pass_lines,optimize_function!(function_node,enabled,maximum_rounds,totals))
    end
    graph_lines,reachable = call_graph_lines(working,"optimized")
    append!(analysis,graph_lines)
    removed = [f.name for f in working.functions if "unreachable" in enabled && !(f.name in reachable)]
    optimized = TACProgram(working.arrays,filter(f->!(f.name in removed),working.functions))
    append!(pass_lines,["== program ==","removed functions: " * comma_list(removed),"== total ==",join(("$name=$(totals[name])" for name in enabled)," ")])
    allocated_functions,allocation_lines = TACFunction[],String[]
    for function_node in optimized.functions
        append!(analysis,function_analysis(function_node,"optimized"))
        allocated_function,lines = allocation_report(function_node,registers)
        push!(allocated_functions,allocated_function)
        append!(allocation_lines,lines)
    end
    allocated = TACProgram(optimized.arrays,allocated_functions)
    reports = (("optimized.tac",program_lines(optimized)),("analysis.txt",analysis),("passes.txt",pass_lines),
        ("regalloc.txt",allocation_lines),("comparison.txt",comparison_report(original,optimized,allocated,runs)))
    for (filename,lines) in reports
        write(joinpath("output",filename),join(lines,"\n") * "\n")
    end
end
main()

function rewrite_code!(function_node,replacements,insertions=Dict{Int,Vector{TACCode}}())
    result = TACCode[]
    number = 0
    for (index,line) in enumerate(function_node.code)
        append!(result,get(insertions,index,TACCode[]))
        if line isa String
            push!(result,line)
        else
            number += 1
            append!(result,get(replacements,number,TACCode[line]))
        end
    end
    append!(result,get(insertions,length(function_node.code)+1,TACCode[]))
    function_node.code = result
end
function fold_instruction(entry)
    entry.kind in ("bin","if") || return entry,false
    a,b = entry.a,entry.b
    first_constant,second_constant = a isa Int,b isa Int
    if first_constant && second_constant
        entry.operation in ("/","%") && b == 0 && return entry,false
        result = calculate(entry.operation,a,b)
        if entry.kind == "if"
            return (result != 0 ? TACInstruction(kind="goto",name=entry.name) : nothing),true
        elseif -2147483648 <= result <= 2147483647
            return TACInstruction(kind="copy",destination=entry.destination,a=result),true
        end
        return entry,false
    end
    (entry.kind != "bin" || first_constant == second_constant) && return entry,false
    op,replacement = entry.operation,nothing
    if op == "+" && (a == 0 || b == 0)
        replacement = first_constant ? b : a
    elseif op == "-" && b == 0
        replacement = a
    elseif op == "*" && (a == 1 || b == 1)
        replacement = first_constant ? b : a
    elseif op == "/" && b == 1
        replacement = a
    elseif op == "*" && (a == 0 || b == 0)
        replacement = 0
    end
    replacement === nothing ? (entry,false) : (TACInstruction(kind="copy",destination=entry.destination,a=replacement),true)
end
function cse_replacements!(function_node,graph,sources,candidates)
    function_node.temporary_serial += 1
    temporary = "_t$(function_node.temporary_serial)"
    replacements = Dict{Int,Vector{TACCode}}()
    for number in sources
        entry = graph.instructions[number]
        replacements[number] = TACCode[replace_instruction(entry;destination=temporary),TACInstruction(kind="copy",destination=entry.destination,a=temporary)]
    end
    for number in candidates
        replacements[number] = TACCode[TACInstruction(kind="copy",destination=graph.instructions[number].destination,a=temporary)]
    end
    temporary,replacements
end
function hoist!(function_node,graph,loop,moves)
    header = graph.blocks[loop.header]
    outside = filter(number->!(number in loop.blocks),header.predecessors)
    replacements = Dict(number=>TACCode[] for number in moves)
    moved = TACCode[graph.instructions[number] for number in moves]
    if loop.header != 1 && length(outside) == 1 && graph.blocks[outside[1]].successors == [loop.header]
        preheader = graph.blocks[outside[1]]
        last = preheader.instructions[end]
        position = graph.positions[last]
        !(graph.instructions[last].kind in ("goto","if")) && (position += 1)
        insertion = moved
        destination = "B$(preheader.number)"
    else
        function_node.preheader_serial += 1
        label = "_p$(function_node.preheader_serial)"
        position = header.start
        insertion = TACCode[label;moved]
        destination = "new " * label
        for number in outside
            last = graph.blocks[number].instructions[end]
            entry = graph.instructions[last]
            if entry.kind in ("goto","if") && entry.name in header.labels
                replacements[last] = TACCode[replace_instruction(entry;name=label)]
            end
        end
    end
    rewrite_code!(function_node,replacements,Dict(position=>insertion))
    destination
end
function remove_unreachable!(function_node,graph)
    blocks = [number for number in eachindex(graph.blocks) if !(number in graph.reachable)]
    deleted = BitSet()
    for number in blocks
        block = graph.blocks[number]
        union!(deleted,block.start:block.finish-1)
    end
    numbers = Dict(position=>number for (number,position) in enumerate(graph.positions))
    remaining = Tuple{TACCode,Int}[(line,get(numbers,index,0)) for (index,line) in enumerate(function_node.code) if !(index in deleted)]
    jumps = Int[]
    for (index,(line,number)) in enumerate(remaining)
        (line isa String || !(line.kind in ("goto","if"))) && continue
        labels = String[]
        following = index+1
        while following <= length(remaining) && remaining[following][1] isa String
            push!(labels,remaining[following][1])
            following += 1
        end
        line.name in labels && push!(jumps,number)
    end
    filter!(pair->!(pair[2] in jumps),remaining)
    targets = Set(line.name for (line,number) in remaining if line isa TACInstruction && line.kind in ("goto","if"))
    labels = String[line for (line,number) in remaining if line isa String && !(line in targets)]
    function_node.code = TACCode[line for (line,number) in remaining if line isa TACInstruction || line in targets]
    blocks,jumps,labels
end

struct TACAllocation
    neighbors::Dict{String,Set{String}}
    costs::Dict{String,BigInt}
    partners::Dict{String,Set{String}}
    order::Vector{String}
    potential::Vector{Tuple{String,Int}}
    colors::Dict{String,Int}
    spills::Set{String}
end
function add_edge!(neighbors,first,second)
    push!(neighbors[first],second)
    push!(neighbors[second],first)
end
function TACAllocation(function_node,graph,flow,registers)
    nodes = Set(function_node.parameters)
    for (number,entry) in enumerate(graph.instructions)
        graph.block_of[number] in graph.reachable || continue
        union!(nodes,used_variables(entry))
        entry.destination !== nothing && push!(nodes,entry.destination)
    end
    neighbors = Dict(node=>Set{String}() for node in nodes)
    costs = Dict(node=>BigInt(0) for node in nodes)
    partners = Dict(node=>Set{String}() for node in nodes)
    for block_number in graph.reachable
        block = graph.blocks[block_number]
        state = copy(flow.live_out[block_number])
        for number in reverse(block.instructions)
            entry = graph.instructions[number]
            destination = entry.destination
            if destination !== nothing
                partner = entry.kind == "copy" ? entry.a : nothing
                for variable in state
                    variable != destination && variable != partner && add_edge!(neighbors,destination,variable)
                end
            end
            state = live_transfer(entry,state)
        end
        weight = big(10)^graph.depth[block_number]
        for number in block.instructions
            entry = graph.instructions[number]
            occurrences = used_variables(entry)
            entry.destination !== nothing && push!(occurrences,entry.destination)
            for variable in occurrences
                costs[variable] += weight
            end
        end
    end
    entry = union(flow.live_in[1],Set(function_node.parameters))
    for parameter in function_node.parameters
        costs[parameter] += 1
        for variable in setdiff(entry,Set([parameter]))
            add_edge!(neighbors,parameter,variable)
        end
    end
    for entry in instructions(function_node)
        if entry.kind == "copy" && entry.a isa String && entry.destination != entry.a
            haskey(partners,entry.destination) && push!(partners[entry.destination],entry.a)
            haskey(partners,entry.a) && push!(partners[entry.a],entry.destination)
        end
    end
    order,potential = String[],Tuple{String,Int}[]
    remaining = copy(nodes)
    while !isempty(remaining)
        degrees = Dict(node=>length(intersect(neighbors[node],remaining)) for node in remaining)
        simple = filter(node->degrees[node] < registers,collect(remaining))
        if !isempty(simple)
            chosen = argmin(node->(degrees[node],node),simple)
        else
            candidates = sort(collect(remaining))
            chosen = candidates[1]
            for node in candidates[2:end]
                costs[node]*degrees[chosen] < costs[chosen]*degrees[node] && (chosen = node)
            end
            push!(potential,(chosen,degrees[chosen]))
        end
        push!(order,chosen)
        delete!(remaining,chosen)
    end
    colors = Dict{String,Int}()
    for node in reverse(order)
        occupied = Set(get(colors,neighbor,-1) for neighbor in neighbors[node])
        free = setdiff(Set(0:registers-1),occupied)
        if isempty(free)
            colors[node] = -1
        else
            preferred = intersect(Set(get(colors,partner,-1) for partner in partners[node]),free)
            colors[node] = minimum(isempty(preferred) ? free : preferred)
        end
    end
    spills = Set(node for (node,color) in colors if color == -1)
    TACAllocation(neighbors,costs,partners,order,potential,colors,spills)
end

const KINDS = ["copy","bin","load","store","goto","if","param","call","return","read","print"]
const TACOperand = Union{Nothing,Int,String}
const TACExpression = Tuple{String,String,TACOperand,TACOperand}
Base.@kwdef struct TACInstruction
    kind::String
    destination::Union{Nothing,String} = nothing
    a::TACOperand = nothing
    b::TACOperand = nothing
    operation::String = ""
    name::String = ""
    count::Int = 0
end
const TACCode = Union{String,TACInstruction}
mutable struct TACFunction
    name::String
    parameters::Vector{String}
    code::Vector{TACCode}
    temporary_serial::Int
    preheader_serial::Int
end
TACFunction(name,parameters,code=TACCode[]) = TACFunction(name,parameters,code,0,0)
struct TACProgram
    arrays::Vector{Tuple{String,Int}}
    functions::Vector{TACFunction}
end
instructions(function_node) = TACInstruction[line for line in function_node.code if line isa TACInstruction]
function replace_instruction(entry;kind=entry.kind,destination=entry.destination,a=entry.a,b=entry.b,
                             operation=entry.operation,name=entry.name,count=entry.count)
    TACInstruction(kind=kind,destination=destination,a=a,b=b,operation=operation,name=name,count=count)
end
function operand_fields(entry)
    entry.kind in ("bin","if","store") && return (:a,:b)
    (entry.kind in ("copy","load","param","print") || (entry.kind == "return" && entry.a !== nothing)) && return (:a,)
    ()
end
used_variables(entry) = String[getproperty(entry,field) for field in operand_fields(entry) if getproperty(entry,field) isa String]
function expression(entry)
    entry.kind == "bin" && return ("bin",entry.operation,entry.a,entry.b)
    entry.kind == "load" && return ("load",entry.name,entry.a,nothing)
    nothing
end
operand(word) = word[1] == '-' || '0' <= word[1] <= '9' ? parse(Int,word) : String(word)
function array_operand(word)
    opening = findfirst('[',word)
    String(word[1:opening-1]),operand(word[opening+1:end-1])
end
function parse_instruction(words)
    first = words[1]
    first == "goto" && return TACInstruction(kind="goto",name=words[2])
    first == "if" && return TACInstruction(kind="if",a=operand(words[2]),b=operand(words[4]),operation=words[3],name=words[6])
    first in ("param","print") && return TACInstruction(kind=first,a=operand(words[2]))
    first == "return" && return TACInstruction(kind="return",a=length(words) == 2 ? operand(words[2]) : nothing)
    first == "read" && return TACInstruction(kind="read",destination=words[2])
    first == "call" && return TACInstruction(kind="call",name=words[2],count=parse(Int,words[3]))
    if '[' in first
        name,index = array_operand(first)
        return TACInstruction(kind="store",a=index,b=operand(words[3]),name=name)
    elseif words[3] == "call"
        return TACInstruction(kind="call",destination=first,name=words[4],count=parse(Int,words[5]))
    elseif length(words) == 5
        return TACInstruction(kind="bin",destination=first,a=operand(words[3]),b=operand(words[5]),operation=words[4])
    elseif '[' in words[3]
        name,index = array_operand(words[3])
        return TACInstruction(kind="load",destination=first,a=index,name=name)
    end
    TACInstruction(kind="copy",destination=first,a=operand(words[3]))
end
function read_program(path)
    arrays,functions = Tuple{String,Int}[],TACFunction[]
    current = nothing
    for line in readlines(path)
        words = split(line)
        (isempty(words) || startswith(words[1],"#")) && continue
        if words[1] == "array"
            push!(arrays,(words[2],parse(Int,words[3])))
        elseif words[1] == "func"
            current = TACFunction(words[2],String.(words[3:end]))
            push!(functions,current)
        elseif words[1] == "end"
            current = nothing
        elseif length(words) == 1 && endswith(words[1],":")
            push!(current.code,String(words[1][1:end-1]))
        else
            push!(current.code,parse_instruction(words))
        end
    end
    TACProgram(arrays,functions)
end
function calculate(operation,first,second)
    operation == "+" && return first+second
    operation == "-" && return first-second
    operation == "*" && return first*second
    operation == "/" && return div(first,second)
    operation == "%" && return rem(first,second)
    result = if operation == "<"
        first < second
    elseif operation == "<="
        first <= second
    elseif operation == ">"
        first > second
    elseif operation == ">="
        first >= second
    elseif operation == "=="
        first == second
    else
        first != second
    end
    Int(result)
end
expression_string(value) = value[1] == "load" ? "$(value[2])[$(value[3])]" : "$(value[3])$(value[2])$(value[4])"
function instruction_string(entry)
    kind = entry.kind
    kind == "copy" && return "$(entry.destination) = $(entry.a)"
    kind == "bin" && return "$(entry.destination) = $(entry.a) $(entry.operation) $(entry.b)"
    kind == "load" && return "$(entry.destination) = $(entry.name)[$(entry.a)]"
    kind == "store" && return "$(entry.name)[$(entry.a)] = $(entry.b)"
    kind == "goto" && return "goto $(entry.name)"
    kind == "if" && return "if $(entry.a) $(entry.operation) $(entry.b) goto $(entry.name)"
    if kind == "call"
        prefix = entry.destination === nothing ? "" : entry.destination * " = "
        return prefix * "call $(entry.name) $(entry.count)"
    end
    kind == "read" && return "read $(entry.destination)"
    kind == "return" && entry.a === nothing && return "return"
    "$kind $(entry.a)"
end
function function_lines(function_node)
    lines = [join(["func",function_node.name,function_node.parameters...]," ")]
    for line in function_node.code
        push!(lines,line isa String ? line * ":" : "    " * instruction_string(line))
    end
    push!(lines,"end")
    lines
end
function program_lines(program)
    sections = Vector{String}[]
    !isempty(program.arrays) && push!(sections,["array $name $size" for (name,size) in program.arrays])
    append!(sections,function_lines.(program.functions))
    lines = String[]
    for section in sections
        !isempty(lines) && push!(lines,"")
        append!(lines,section)
    end
    lines
end
